description: SmartVisuals News Ticker puts the television lower third on your Power BI report: a strip of headlines, KPIs and alerts that scrolls straight out of your data model. Built for wall-mounted dashboards, operations rooms, receptions and any report that deserves a pulse. Everything is free. Every feature, for every viewer, with no licence, no watermark and no blocked report. What it does Any text you already have - map a Headline field and you have a working ticker. Badge, Image, Value and Change are optional extras. Badge chips coloured per category, and listed in the format pane under your own badge names rather than "Badge 1". Up and down deltas with arrows and colours, invertible for cost, defect and downtime metrics, honouring the format string on your measures. Horizontal or vertical - a broadcast strip running either direction, or a vertical news column where long headlines wrap instead of being cut off. Up to five rows, with items dealt across them and the rows running staggered so they never march in lockstep. Per-item logos from base64 images stored in your own model. Change flash - an item whose numbers moved marks itself on the next refresh, so a wall display shows you what just happened. Announcement - type a message in the format pane and it runs on its own, with no fields mapped at all. Cross-filtering - click an item and the rest of the report follows, with…
